title: GitHub API Demo-2
description:
GitHub API Demo is an Android app that works with GitHub online and shows your items in scrolling lists.

One screen: Main.
Tap: Load profile and List repositories.

What it does:
• Works with GitHub online
• Shows your items in scrolling lists
• Lets you type and save your own text

Made with Sketchware AI · Material 3 design · Android 5.0 to 17.
changelog:
## GitHub API Demo v1.0 (1): first release

- **1 screen**: MainActivity.java
- 7 widgets, 33 logic blocks, 1 variable
- Widgets: 2 Button, 2 TextView, 1 EditText, 1 LinearLayout, 1 ListView
- Components: GitHub
- Libraries: AppCompat & Material
- Android 5.0 (API 21) to 17 (API 37)
- Material 3 design
